digest_scope: Setup-owned replay/table program identities, NOT a complete R1CS, verification-key or proof identity.
source_hashes_scope: Every new or modified Rust source relative to base_revision, frozen before the bounded proof-free run. No Rust source changed during measurement. Other code/dependencies are unchanged; documentation/report edits do not affect the running binary.

setup_emission.owner: Immutable CompiledExecRootClosure, borrowing approved CompiledExecReplay and owning all exact root programs.
setup_emission.relation_inputs: Approved setup only. No guest, statement, expected Q, commitment components, proof, native replay witness or replacement trace.
setup_emission.matrix_api: build_setup_r1cs(ExecSetupR1csLimitsV0) creates a shape-only builder, calls the whole closed composition, checks builder and emitter errors, validates exactly two public variables, and returns only CanonicalR1csV1 on complete success.
setup_emission.stream_api: emit_setup(shape_only_builder, source_payload_limit) emits that same whole composition. Source preflight errors must be propagated; builder/observer refusals are sticky. No replay/assignment/acceptance output is returned.
setup_emission.values: All source slots use non-witness zero scratch. Private zero is never a shape constant. Inline B/I/O stay private and Q stays two public variables; zero scratch does not pin a guest or expected public digest.
setup_emission.checks: Only redundant native-value diagnostics are suppressed in shape mode. Structural validation and transcript/PoW, statement, inverse x*inv=1, algebra, PCS/Merkle, all folds and exact-root equalities remain. Ordinary witness diagnostics are preserved.
setup_emission.source_budget_scope: Heap-backed source-slot payload only, checked before allocation; excludes Vec/allocator overhead, inline B/I/O/Q, approved setup/tables, gadget intermediates and matrices. Not a peak-RAM or whole-pipeline admission.

ordinary_regression.shape_tests: Modes cannot export a witness; exact matrix equality with valid assignments; bounds include ONE and reject before retaining over-budget rows/terms; first error remains sticky across allocations/enforcement/all finish modes; malformed wire indices/topology fail.

materialized_components.negatives: Every challenge bit; invalid challenge-source geometry. Setup zeroes compression witness columns, payload and expected challenge.
Public Q, fixed words, statement outputs, registry/circuit/counts/padding/public-vector payload wires.
All result/inverse bits. Setup has an initially false equality and zero inverse scratch; ordinary zero inverse still fails.
All root-value bits and missing claim topology; setup zeroes source/digest values.
All root-value bits and missing claim topology; setup zeroes source/digest values.
Both Eq and Combo row encodings; all root-value bits, header/scale/address/value/digest source mutations; malformed challenge count; ordinary invalid digest rejection.

ordinary_regression.scope: Actual canonical component matrix equality and satisfying-assignment checks, NOT complete closed Exec matrices or a terminal proof.

debug_setup_regression.scope: Unoptimized build with debug assertions enabled; all setup-mode builder/component tests selected by setup_. Overlapped the bounded whole-relation emission; neither duration is a controlled throughput comparison.

native_regression.command: ulimit -v 33554432 && RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 timeout 180 cargo test --release --locked --manifest-path flock-stage4/Cargo.toml -p ixby-stage4-exec native::tests::closure_tests::setup_owned_closure_matches_all_real_fold_roots -- --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture
native_regression.timing_scope: The preproof interval includes both root compilations and source/prefix/budget checks. The full ordinary suite overlapped this regression; these are observed timings, not a controlled performance comparison.
native_regression.prefix_scope: Captured setup prefix exists before any guest/proof and is compared exactly with all three witness-driven prefixes. This early prefix is not a full-circuit digest or full matrix equality claim.
native_regression.memory_scope: Cumulative test-process counters including approved native setup, not a terminal prover or process-tree measurement.

bounded_emission.command: ulimit -v 33554432 && RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 timeout 1800 cargo test --release --locked --manifest-path flock-stage4/Cargo.toml -p ixby-stage4-exec native::tests::closure_tests::proof_free_root_closed_supported_domain_admission_census -- --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture
bounded_emission.timing_scope: Emission timing starts after approved setup and root compilation; total test duration includes them and excludes Cargo compilation. The run constructed no guest or Flock proof. Clippy overlapped its start and the 61.18-second debug setup suite overlapped later emission, so this is not a controlled throughput comparison with the witness-driven baseline.
bounded_emission.comparison_scope: The three prefix counts and last phase exactly match the earlier witness-driven cutoff. Neither rejected stream produces a full R1CS digest; this is not whole-matrix equality or a reusable complete key. Exact materialized component matrices and the 4096-row real-Exec prefix are checked separately.
bounded_emission.memory_scope: Linux cumulative test-process counters, including approved native setup and root programs. Not terminal prover RSS, a process-tree measurement, or a memory minimum. No complete matrices/assignment or terminal SRS/key are retained.
bounded_emission.interpretation: The emitted prefix plus two public and two blinding rows already exceeds the supported 2^30 domain. Full relation cost is still unknown. Stopping at the first over-budget row does not mean deleting one row would make the relation fit. Cost redesign is required before full materialization, key preprocessing and proving.
bounded_emission.scope: Same entire closed relation, emitted ONLY from approved setup and stopped by the supported-domain cap. No guest, Flock proof, valid assignment, terminal SRS/key or complete matrices are constructed. A refused prefix cannot establish a completed census or authorize terminal proving.

remaining_gates: Feasible complete closed geometry, complete materialization and proof-free key preprocessing, actual FFLONK proof and fresh isolated verification, whole-pipeline resource admission, and the original M3/M4/M7/M8 formal/scaling/compiler/upgrade obligations remain.
